Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is ready to move toward contracting. We have a couple of asks before we lock dates:

1) We'd like a "redline roundtable" with legal and procurement where we go through the MSA redlines together (target ~60–90 minutes).
2) Can you share a doc pack (SOC2 evidence index, retention policy, sample audit logs) ahead of that call so our InfoSec can start vetting?

- I’ve looped Jordan (account lead) and Markus (legal) plus Laura from CS to make scheduling straightforward.

Proposed windows (all PST):
- Tue 2026-11-30 09:00–10:00 PST (legal-only deep-dive)

- Alternate: Wed 2026-12-01 08:30–09:30 PST (single 60-min)

We’ll share a doc pack link if these look workable; otherwise tell me preferred days/times and we’ll adjust. I’ll also attach a short evidence index (CSV) for your InfoSec team to scan.
